text:
samir: Heads-up — we need to schedule the dedicated migration for NovaEdge (customer 47). Proposing a staggered migration across 3 slices to avoid cold-start spikes. Details below.

elaine: SGTM. what window are you thinking?

samir: Proposal: Wed 2026-04-15 01:00-05:00 UTC. Slice A 01:00-02:00, B 02:30-03:30, C 04:00-05:00. 30m buffer between slices for checks.

raj: Can we pin model version to v2.3.1-optimized for the migration? want deterministic perf.

samir: Yes—pinning to v2.3.1-optimized across Dedicated pools. fallback plan to v2.2.9-qq if errors.

molly: Dependency check: no schema changes; config flags will stay same. Will prepare release notes + run smoke evals.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: service=dedicated-migration, customer=NovaEdge, start=2026-04-15T01:00:00Z, slices=3. To cancel: /deploy cancel 1881234567

katie: need legal aware? This is Private customer with stricter window. Legal signed SLA; ops only.

elaine: Ops oncall ok? tagging @raj for infra readiness.

raj: oncall available, will provision extra capacity and monitor KV cache hitrates. Alert thresholds: 2xx error rate >1% or p99 latency +40% -> rollback.

samir: Rollback plan: immediate pin to v2.2.9-qq, infra auto-fallback to mirrored pool in us-west if p99 >750ms for >3min.

molly: I'll attach the eval report before handoff and add best-readme steps for support.

samir: Can I get :thumbsup: from product and customer success to greenlight?

elaine: :thumbsup:

raj: :thumbsup:

katie: :thumbsup: from CS, I'll notify customer with exact windows and ask them to drain heavy jobs.

molly: FYI tests: run smoke suite, perf-run with 20k tokens across slices pre-rollout at 00:00 UTC.

infra-bot: perf-run scheduled: run_id=pr-1881234567-1, start=2026-04-15T00:00:00Z, artifacts will be posted in #eng-releases.

samir: Ok, locking schedule and pin. I'll post release notes and runbook in the customer dossier. If anything changes ping here.

deploy-bot: Reminder 24h: dedicated-migration for NovaEdge starts 2026-04-15T01:00:00Z. Thread=1881234567

samir: thanks all. closing for now.
